children: On September 9, several major gold jewelry brands in China lowered their domestic pure-gold jewelry prices from the previous day, according to Jiemian News. Lao Feng Xiang quoted 1,318 yuan per gram, down 15 yuan; Lao Miao Gold quoted 1,313 yuan per gram, down 19 yuan; Chow Sang Sang quoted 1,317 yuan per gram, down 19 yuan; and Chow Tai Fook quoted 1,317 yuan per gram, down 18 yuan.

title: China Gold Jewelry Prices Fall Across Major Brands on September 9
